harnesses.label: claude
args: Before anything else, read AGENTS.md in the working directory. It explains that you are running inside a Strudel desktop app beside a live editor, and how to reach the code.

harnesses.label: pi
args: Before handling the first request, read AGENTS.md in the working directory. It explains the live Strudel editor, the current session boundary, the .strudel-live.json snapshot, and how to edit beat files. Read ../../app/README.md only when you need desktop implementation detail. Treat this as a fresh helper session for the current beat and use the environment, docs, and available skills rather than asking the captain to restate them.
